3. DEEP ROLLOUT SIMULATION (the key innovation matching AutoCT)

Why Deep Rollout Matters for Clinical Trial Features
"biomarker_available" alone scores acc=0.53. But combined with "drug_targets" + "mechanism_novelty" the trio scores 0.78.
This epistasis (feature interaction) is only discoverable by going deep. Without deep rollout, MCTS stays at depth 2.
Best-on-path: the node with highest hypervolume on the rollout path is backpropagated (not just the leaf).
